public function describe(shape: Shape) returns Text
  purpose: One line naming the shape and giving its area.
  example: describe(Point) is "a point with area 0.00"
  example: describe(Rectangle(width: 2, height: 3)) is "a 2 by 3 rectangle with area 6.00"

  let area_value be shape.area()
  let cents be (area_value * 100).rounded()
  let whole be cents.quotient(100)
  let part be cents remainder 100
  let part_text be if part is less than 10 then "0{part}" otherwise "{part}" end
  let amount be "{whole}.{part_text}"
  match shape
    when Circle(radius) then return "a circle of radius {radius} with area {amount}"
    when Rectangle(width, height) then return "a {width} by {height} rectangle with area {amount}"
    when Point then return "a point with area {amount}"
  end
end
```

```
public function describe(shape: Shape) returns Text
  purpose: One line naming the shape and giving its area.
  example: describe(Point) is "a point with area 0.00"
  example: describe(Rectangle(width: 2, height: 3)) is "a 2 by 3 rectangle with area 6.00"

  let exact_area be shape.area()
  let area_text be (exact_area * 100).rounded().to_decimal() / 100 + 0.00
  match shape
    when Circle(radius) then return "a circle of radius {radius} with area {area_text}"
    when Rectangle(width, height) then return "a {width} by {height} rectangle with area {area_text}"
    when Point then return "a point with area {area_text}"
  end
end
